# Arnold Boecklin ExtraBold

By Maurizio Loreti, University of Padova, Department of Physics.
Source: https://pup.aminet.net/text/ifont/ABoecklin.lha
Original distribution terms and attribution: ABoecklin.readme (preserved verbatim).
The author states: "The font has been designed with TypeSmith 2.05, and is freely distributable."

arnold-boecklin-extrabold.woff2 is a browser-compatible conversion of the archive's
ABoecklin-ExtraBold.pfb. Original outlines, advance widths and the AFM kerning
pairs are retained. This is Loreti's ExtraBold implementation, not the commercial
Linotype or URW digital font. Only the study's object labels use this font.
